title: rabdosia henryi
intro: Rabdosia henryi, commonly known as Henry's Rabdosia or Tibetan Enzian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is a shrubby perennial plant native to the Himalayas and China, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rabdosia henryi include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The plant's bioactive constituents, including diterpenoid alkaloids such as isorenieriene and renieriene, exhibit therapeutic actions including analgesic, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
